title: The maximal mean equicontinuous factor via regional mean sensitivity
summary: For actions of amenable groups, mean equicontinuity-a natural relaxation of equicontinuity obtained by averaging metrics along orbits-is well known to yield a maximal mean equicontinuous factor. In 2021, Li and Yu introduced the notion of weak sensitivity in the mean for actions of $\mathbb{Z}$ to gain a deeper understanding of this phenomenon, building on earlier work by Qiu and Zhao. We demonstrate that this relation is insufficient for actions of non-Abelian groups.
